digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill and defect tracking workflow
propositions: rebar-debug skill closes bugs without recording the originating ticket that introduced the defect, preventing escape rate measurement

the fallback blame derivation fails to detect producer-consumer mismatches where the fix site differs from the cause site, incorrectly attributing defects to old consumer code instead of producer changes that shipped unmet obligations
the skill must explicitly trace implicated lines through git history to identify the introducing change and recover the originating ticket via commit trailer or subject before closing the bug
rebar transition close must include --caused-by on the flag even when the caused_by link was previously recorded via rebar link, to prevent duplicate guessed edges
worktree bootstrap in both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must use make worktree to provision the virtualenv and run commands with the worktree venv on PATH to avoid pre-commit hook failures
